Pure black background in dark mode. Saves battery on OLED screens.
Turn off dynamic colour to pick an accent

Choose Document, ID card, Book or Whiteboard mode for what you want to scan. With auto-capture on, hold the camera steady and let it take the picture. You can also tap the shutter yourself. If a page is blurry or cut off, retake it.

Drag the corner or edge handles to change the crop. Use Auto to detect the page edges or Full to keep the whole image. Pinch to zoom in the filter preview and press and hold to compare with the unfiltered page.

Tap Save to keep the scan as a document in your Library. Use Export to make a PDF, JPG or PNG, or Share PDF to send a copy. Open a single page in the page viewer and choose Save image to export just that page. Saved PDFs go to Documents/Scanly and saved images go to Pictures/Scanly.
Tap the Unsaved scan card in the Library to pick up where you left off. When you start another scan, tap Save it and start new to keep the previous pages as a separate document.
Pick your images and tap Run to make a PDF with your current options. Choose Adjust pages to open the images as a scan so you can fix crops and filters before saving and exporting.
Tap the page to hide or show the bars. You can lock full screen and press and hold to unlock it. Use tabs to switch between open PDFs, search for text and add annotations to pages.
Open Tools and choose what you want to do with your PDFs or images. Check the options for the tool before you run it.
Merge combines PDFs into one file.
Split saves selected pages as separate PDFs.
Page edits lets you move, rotate, insert, duplicate, extract or delete pages.
Same width scales pages to a common width.
Print layout arranges pages on sheets and can add page labels.
Page numbers adds numbers to the pages.
Password adds or removes password protection.
Metadata lets you edit details such as the title and author.
Sanitize removes hidden data such as metadata, scripts, attachments and form actions.
Grayscale makes images in a PDF gray.
Images → PDF combines images into a PDF.
PDF → Images saves PDF pages as images.
Batch runs a tool on multiple PDFs.
Search for documents by name and use sorting to change their order. Organise your documents into folders and mark favourites for quick access. Switch between list and grid views.

You can use Scanly fully offline, and the app has no internet permission. Turn on App lock in Settings to protect access with your device credentials. Use Backup and restore to keep a copy of your library in a folder you choose.
